title: 2213-A Overseas Graduate Scholarship Program (Only PhD.)
institution: TÜBİTAK (Scientific and Technological Research Council of Türkiye), BİDEB
about: TÜBİTAK BİDEB scholarship programme for doctoral study abroad. The 2026/1 call opened on 13 May 2026; applications are made online through the TÜBİTAK system and evaluated periodically.
requirements: Final-year undergraduates, graduates, current graduate students or master's holders may apply (per programme FAQ)

upskill.name: EduCut AI Academy course catalog
why: The programme covers all fields and states no subject requirement that a specific course objective covers, so the post links to the Academy catalog.
